typography.guidelines: Serif (Playfair) for premium cinematic titles. Sans-serif (Outfit) for all highly readable body text and UI controls. Handwritten (Dancing Script) for emotional, personal accents and notes. Use tracking-tight on massive text, tracking-wide on tiny overlines. Never use Inter or Space Grotesk.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Ultra-premium glass styling: backdrop-blur-xl or 2xl, subtle 1px white/60 border, inner white glow, ambient colored drop shadow. NEVER use plain transparent backgrounds for UI components.
visual_enhancers.living_background: Implement floating particles (fireflies, sparkles, petals) globally using framer-motion or tsparticles. Background should shift dynamically like an aurora.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Use soft, organic, asymmetrical shapes. Section dividers should be SVG curves, clouds, or waves-not straight horizontal lines.
visual_enhancers.cursor: Custom glowing cursor trailing particles (framer-motion coordinates). Hide default cursor.

layouts.1_Intro_Curtain: Fixed absolute full-screen z-[100]. Black background. 2 image panels of red velvet curtains meeting in middle. Curtains slide left/right on trigger.
layouts.2_DOB_Lock: Center glassmorphic card (max-w-md). 'Enter your birthday' prompt. Input field. Password is '01012000'. Shake animation (x: [-10,10,-10,10,0]) on fail. Success triggers bright glow and fade out.
layouts.3_Name_Reveal: Cinematic text sequence. Huge glassy 'A' appears first, light sweep across it. Letters 'R S H I A' slide out from inside 'A'. Word dissolves into floating particles transitioning to Hero.
layouts.4_Hero: min-h-screen with soft aurora gradient. Large 'Happy Birthday, Kiddo!' heading. Floating Hero Photo ('pink dress') in a premium glass frame. Floating balloons/butterflies behind. Scroll indicator pulsing.
layouts.5_The_Story: Vertical timeline. Central glowing line (rose gold). 5 glassmorphic cards alternating left and right. Parallax scroll effect for each card.
layouts.6_Photo_Gallery: Interactive scrapbook layout. Do NOT use a grid. Staggered, rotated polaroids floating in 2D space. Hover brings photo to top and scales. Click opens lightbox.
layouts.7_Moving_Memories: Horizontal scrolling film-strip / cinema reel. Autoplaying looping videos or photo slideshow. Glassy film-strip borders.
layouts.8_Memory_Jar: Large glass jar image centered. Floating particles inside. Click jar -> A folded paper rises, unfolds, and typewriter animation reveals a core memory. Counter updates.
layouts.9_Letters_Mood: 6 premium wax-sealed envelopes in a 3x2 grid. Hover: Envelope lifts. Click: Flap opens (rotateX 180), paper slides up, typewriter text appears.
layouts.10_Secret_Letter: Single central vintage paper element. Wax seal in center. Typewriter text slowly reveals when scrolled into view.
layouts.11_Wheel_Surprises: Circular SVG wheel with 10 pastel segments. Central glass spin button. Realistic physics-based spin using Framer Motion. Popup glass card reveals the result.
layouts.12_Birthday_Wish: 3D-ish Cake image with glowing candles. Button 'Make a Wish'. Click triggers candle fade, room lights up, massive confetti explosion using react-confetti.
layouts.13_Compliments: Single glass card in center. Click triggers 3D flip (rotateY 180). New compliment displayed on the other side.
layouts.14_Best_Friend_Meter: Animated SVG gauge or horizontal liquid bar. Starts at 0%, races to 99%, stalls, hits 100% and triggers fireworks.
layouts.15_Music_Player: Floating glass widget bottom-right. Play/pause icons. Spinning vinyl animation.
layouts.16_Outro: Full-screen emotional thank you note. Soft pastel firework background. 'Happy Birthday Arshia'.

motion.scroll: Lenis smooth scroll is MANDATORY for premium momentum feel.
motion.animations: Framer Motion for all interactions. Use spring physics ({ type: 'spring', stiffness: 100, damping: 20 }). Staggered list reveals and parallax essential.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, lucide-react, react-confetti, tsparticles, react-tsparticles, @studio-freight/react-lenis.
Implement a robust global state or Context for the 'Unlock' and 'Cinematic Intro' sequence so the rest of the page does not render or scroll until unlocked.
DO NOT use generic Shadcn components out of the box-strip their default borders/bg and apply the custom glassmorphism classes.
Ensure the custom cursor and floating background elements do not interfere with pointer events (use pointer-events: none).
Apply `data-testid` to the password input, unlock button, memory jar, envelopes, spin wheel, and cake for testing.
All text over images or gradients must use text-shadow for WCAG contrast.
Avoid straight line dividers. Use custom SVG paths for waves, clouds, or jagged scrapbook tears between sections.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: DO NOT output generic 'AI slop' designs. Add layered depth and subtle noise/grain overlays to create the 'handcrafted premium' feel.
Never apply `transition: all` as it ruins Framer Motion transforms.
Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`. Keep text naturally aligned unless explicitly requested.
Use glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl, white/40 border, slight white/20 bg) for all containers instead of flat colored blocks.
Include high-fidelity micro-interactions (e.g., hover scaling, soft glows) on all interactive elements.
Prioritize optical alignment over strict geometric alignment for visual perfection.
